Current Firebase documentation states that Admin SDK on Google environments should use Application Default Credentials and that Firestore server libraries bypass Security Rules and rely on IAM.

Current Cloud Run documentation recommends a dedicated user-managed service account with the minimum permissions required by the service and documents the Firebase/Identity Platform end-user pattern: a public web app sends an ID token to a public Cloud Run service, which verifies that token in application code.

Stage 2H is therefore selected as a non-provisioning Production Trusted Execution Runtime & Least-Privilege IAM Boundary using a dedicated Cloud Run HTTPS service, dedicated user-managed service identity, Application Default Credentials, minimum Firestore permissions and independent application authorization.
